detailed_description:
The target video is a 15-second 2D anime / donghua sequence with rich cel-shaded character animation, painterly backgrounds, warm amber lantern light against cold neon night, in the style of <Picture 1>.
[Shot 1] The video opens on a wide interior of <Subject 4>, the antique wooden dragon-train carriage from <Picture 1> cell (1,1): hanging warm lanterns sway gently, casting amber light across carved wood panels and lattice windows. <Subject 2> Gui Yue, in her light cyan hanfu with pink ribbon and jade earring, leans absentmindedly against the window while a blurred neon-lit city nightscape streaks past outside. The camera holds static, then begins a slow push-in toward her sorrowful, glistening-eyed face (cell 1,3) as her fingertips unconsciously trace the edge of the window frame.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a static over-shoulder view from behind Gui Yue, her pink bow visible in the foreground (cell 2,1), toward <Subject 1> Liu Lang in his dark navy robes with topknot and sword at his side, looking down intently at <Subject 3>, the open ancient map with verbatim "落魂澤" and hand-drawn terrain. A brief POV insert of the map in his hands (cell 3,2) occupies roughly 3–4.5s. He suddenly stops, lifts his head, and looks straight at Gui Yue; the camera holds a medium close-up (cell 2,2) with a gentle push-in on his face as <Subject 1> (S1) speaks in a low, serious, sincere voice with unwavering eyes, <d>[English] This journey is perilous. If we make it back alive, I will help you avenge your parents.</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to an extreme close-up of <Subject 2> Gui Yue's wide shocked eyes (cell 2,3): her pupils dilate instantly, her body stiffens, and her lips part slightly in disbelief as the unexpected promise strikes her deepest pain. The camera is static with a very slow push-in.
[Shot 4] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to the exterior night view of <Subject 5> (cell 3,1): the massive mechanical dragon head with fierce glowing red eyes leads the lit train through towering cyberpunk skyscrapers, tearing across the heavy night sky, red light flashing on wet steel. The camera performs a slow lateral tracking move alongside the dragon head.
[Shot 5] At 00:13.000, the shot cuts back to the quiet two-shot inside <Subject 4> (cell 3,3): <Subject 1> Liu Lang has lowered his head again over <Subject 3>, the map, as if the vow carries immense weight yet feels entirely natural; <Subject 2> Gui Yue continues to watch him, the shock in her eyes transformed into unprecedented determination. The lanterns sway as the carriage rocks gently; the camera holds static to the end, the two seated facing each other in a silent, sacred pact.
